reviews.title: Clean design and easy to build in
reviews.comment:
This case looks really nice in person. The layout is clean, and it gives you enough space to work without feeling cramped. I liked how easy it was to route cables and keep the build looking organized. The ARGB lighting adds a nice touch without making the case look cheap or overdone.

Airflow seems solid, and the case feels well made overall. It is a good choice if you want something that looks modern but is still practical for a gaming PC. I would recommend it to someone who cares about both looks and airflow.
